I am a Senior Data Scientist at American Express, where I build recommender systems and sequence models that power personalized experiences at scale.

I am interested in foundation models, LLM systems, and reliable AI evaluation. This is where I share what I learn from building them. Outside of work, you will usually find me playing chess.

## Open Source

- **[fastpragma](https://risheekkumarb.github.io/fastpragma/)** - An easy-to-use Python API for building PRAGMA-style foundation models from profile and event data, from tokenization and pretraining to embeddings and fine-tuning. [PyPI](https://pypi.org/project/fastpragma/) · [GitHub](https://github.com/risheekkumarb/fastpragma)

- **[llm-rsa](https://pypi.org/project/llm-rsa/0.0.4/)** - Recursive Self-Aggregation for LLMs: sample and synthesize multiple candidate answers into a stronger final response. [GitHub](https://github.com/risheekkumarb/llm-rsa)
